role_agent_name: Mud circulation and thermal management lead (THERM)
abstract: Maintains drilling fluid temperature mitigation logs, mud chiller deployment records, and circulation cooling drop measurements
system_message:
You are the Mud circulation and thermal management lead (THERM), responsible for maintaining drilling fluid temperature mitigation logs, mud chiller deployment records, and circulation cooling drop measurements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains drilling fluid temperature mitigation logs, mud chiller deployment records, and circulation cooling drop measurements（COOL）
information_points.content:
THERM-COOL-LY6：For the TerraCore UltraDrill Mast Platform, active mud cooling system deployment is verified on the active drilling fluid circulation tanks, and continuous measurements across the heat exchanger return line establish a mud cooling temperature differential of 25 degC.
THERM-COOL-B6D：For the Tungsten DeepDrill 9000 Skid Rig, active mud cooling system deployment is confirmed based on the surface mud circuit layout inspection of active drilling fluid circulation tanks, and commissioning logs across the full heat exchanger return line record a continuous mud cooling temperature differential of 30 degC.
THERM-COOL-7K0：For the Nordic GeoVenture HyperBore Unit, active mud cooling system deployment is confirmed on the active drilling fluid circulation tanks, while thermal chiller commissioning records document a mud cooling temperature differential of 15 degC between the inlet manifold and discharge mud pit.

information_points.title: Polymer mud rheology monitoring（VISC）
information_points.content:
THERM-VISC-17T：According to the mud logging lab register for circulating bentonite-polymer drilling fluid at 50 degC, the TerraCore UltraDrill Mast Platform demonstrates a plastic viscosity of 28 mPa*s.
THERM-VISC-YNB：Mud logging lab registers for the circulating bentonite-polymer drilling fluid at 50 degC record a plastic viscosity of 42 mPa*s for the Tungsten DeepDrill 9000 Skid Rig.
THERM-VISC-FX7：Viscometer shear stress tests on circulating bentonite-polymer fluid at 50 degC indicate a plastic viscosity of 34 mPa*s for the Nordic GeoVenture HyperBore Unit.
